🖱️ SpeedClick

Race against the clock: you have a limited time window (usually 10 seconds) to click as many times as possible. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click or tap the button as rapidly as possible.
  2. The timer counts down — work fast.
  3. Both mouse clicks and screen taps count.
  4. Try to maintain a consistent high speed throughout — don't burn out early.
  5. Experiment with one-finger vs two-finger tapping to find your fastest technique.
